name: Voyageurs National Park
policyReason: Pets are allowed in developed areas and on the Rainy Lake Recreation Trail, not other trails or the backcountry.
summary: Pets are allowed in developed areas and on the Rainy Lake Recreation Trail, not other trails or the backcountry.

excerpts.quote: Pets are NOT allowed on park trails (except the Rainy Lake Recreation Trail) or in the backcountry.

dogRules.text: Developed areas, the four main lakes and entrance roads.
Dog sleds allowed on frozen lakes; permit needed on snowmobile portages.
